throttled_evidence: GPU clock pinned min==max in the gate; bracketed isolated runs drifted 0.0 % (prefix) and 0.6 % (expert), which is the drift check non-negotiable 3 asks for.
not_measured: compiled bf16_both co-run: the stock path corrupts non-deterministically when pipelined across two streams (max|d| 1.273 on one run, all-NaN on another) while compiled SERIAL is correct and eager PIPELINED is bitwise exact. See scratch/NOTE_e12_compiled_two_stream.txt. Needs the own-CUDAGraph fallback of spec §7 before any compiled co-run number can be reported.
Step 4 (MODE_30W, 8 SMs): waits for the owner's capped-mode reboot, per spec §5 Step 4 and §11, which permit the MAXN part to be marked done.
Step 3 mechanisms (stream priority -3, graphs on both stages, green contexts, libsmctrl, MPS, two processes): not yet attempted.
notes: NO OVERLAP OCCURRED. T_pipe equals A_iso + B_iso, and host issue/wall = 1.0000 -- the CPU spends the entire wall clock issuing kernels, so the two streams never both have resident work. s and p therefore read ~1.00 because each stage ran with the GPU to itself, NOT because overlap was ideal. Only T_pipe separates those two readings.

pi0 eager is launch-bound: E5 measured ae_step at 84.2 % GPU idle over 968 kernels per step. GPU contention (KerColle's head-of-line blocking) cannot arise in a configuration that never fills the GPU, so this configuration cannot answer that question -- the compiled rung is where it becomes answerable.

mechanism=pi0_nosync memoises the constant att_masks tensors at modeling_pi0.py:681 (per prefix) and :746 (per denoise step), removing 1+N host syncs per frame. A LABELLED harness change per spec §7, verified to keep the fresh-KV equivalence bitwise identical. It also made the expert stage ~19 % faster at N=4 (226.81 -> 184.18 ms), which is an optimisation for the shipping model independent of E12.

r = 2.7395 here, NOT E7's 1.50. In eager the expert is the longer stage (652.9 vs 1788.6 ms); under bf16_both the prefix is (251.28 vs 167.36). Compiling speeds the expert more than the prefix and flips which stage sets the period, so r must come from the same session.
